top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete, independently confirmed arc: Holst on incretin physiology and human insulinotropic action, Mojsov on identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) form, and Drucker on receptor biology and intestinotropic actions. Maturity is very high, with decades of confirmation and large randomised outcome trials. The citation on physiology and the active peptide, with therapy as consequence, keeps the prize on discovery and the allocation maps cleanly onto distinct steps. No award is not warranted.
